title: Ending the organisation's service has no confirmation at all within 4 minutes of signing in, and is audited with no reason
evidence: audit_logs 2026-09-03T23:33:04.659233+00:00 action=organization_offboarding_requested actor='בעלים לדוגמה (owner)' reason=null; 23:37:13.312972+00:00 action=organization_offboarding_cancelled same actor reason=null. organization_access_state went 'active' -> 'offboarding' -> 'active'; the tenant was read-only for 4m08.65s and rpc/request_webhook_verification answered HTTP 403 webhook_organization_read_only throughout. Source: Settings.tsx:883-896 mounts the offboarding ReauthModal with only open/title/onConfirm/onCancel - no skipWhenFresh (defaults true), no reasonLabel (so no reason box exists), no details (so the dialog never states the consequence). ReauthModal.tsx FRESH_PASSWORD_WINDOW_SECONDS = 4*60. Measured empirically on the cancel half of the same component: the click produced no [role=dialog] before the RPC fired. Screenshots 40-settings-offboarding.png, 51-cancel-clicked.png.
repro: Sign in as owner. Within 4 minutes, on /settings, activate 'בקשת סיום שירות'. The whole organisation is in read-only immediately: no dialog, no confirm, no password, no reason. It happened for real in this sweep - another agent's contrast script matched the button by the Hebrew substring /יום/, which is inside 'סיום'.
expected: An org-wide switch to read-only, reversible only for 30 days and after that only by a platform admin, should be at least as guarded as revoking one invitation - which in the same file goes through ConfirmDialog with tone 'danger' and requireReason. The dialog should name what stops working and that it is reversible until the deadline, and the audit row should carry a reason.
actual: No dialog renders at all inside the 4-minute freshness window. audit_logs records both the request and the cancellation with reason=null, so neither half of an org-wide switch is attributed to a stated purpose.

title: The price-list review queue asks for 737 human decisions and shows no prices on any of them
evidence: Screenshot 44-doc-operations-bottom.png. Table 'מחירונים שממתינים לבדיקה', columns מחירון | מה צריך לבדוק | מוצר | מחיר נוכחי ← מוצע | פעולות. Footer reads '737 רשומות', pager '1 / 74'. Every row on the page reads 'נדרשת החלטה' and the price cell reads '— ← —'. Sampled 10 of 10 rows on page 1; agent-owner-14-final.mjs captured the same for every row it read.
expected: A queue that asks an operator to decide on a proposed price shows the current price and the proposed price, so there is something to decide between.
actual: Both figures render as an em dash on every row. 737 rows across 74 pages ask for a decision and carry no number to decide on. The em dash itself is correct per the constitution (— not 0); the defect is that the decision queue has no data. The document is also identified only by a raw UUID filename (8b618ed3-9a14-446f-b1dd-604f1fc63574.jpeg).

title: A verification handshake the server reports as failed is shown to the owner as an open, pending request
evidence: Wire: rpc/request_webhook_verification -> 200 {verification_id: b3dfd20a-…}; functions/v1/webhook-verify -> HTTP 200 body {"ok":true,"verified":false,"code":"webhook_verification_status_405"}. Screen after 20s (screenshot 71-verify-outcome.png): badge changed 'טרם אומת' -> 'אימות ממתין', note reads 'בקשת אימות פתוחה בתוקף עד 04.09.2026, 02:54'. Toast captured from [role=status],[role=alert]: null. No failure text anywhere on the screen.
repro: Owner -> /settings/webhooks -> 'אימות נקודת הקצה' -> give a reason -> 'שליחת אימות', against an endpoint that does not answer the challenge.
expected: The server answered verified:false. The owner should be told the handshake failed and what to do next. #98 correctly forbids showing the raw upstream body, but a failure class ('the endpoint did not accept the request') is not a raw body.
actual: The screen states the opposite of what happened: it shows a pending request open for another 15 minutes. An owner will wait out a window for a handshake that has already definitively failed, and will get no message when it expires either.

title: A successful price-list import is listed under the subject 'שורת מחירון שנמחקה' - a deletion that never happened
evidence: Screenshot 21-supplier-log.png. Two rows, 04.09.2026 01:55 and 01:59, action 'קליטת מחירון' (audit_logs.action = supplier_prices_imported), subject 'שורת מחירון שנמחקה', change 'אין נתוני מחיר', reasons 'בדיקת QA — סריקת רגרסיה 04.09.2026' and 'בדיקת QA — שחזור מחירים מקוריים 04.09.2026'. Mechanism, SupplierLog.tsx:172: for entity_type='supplier_products' the subject is [product, supplier].join(' · ') || t('supplierLog.filter'), and he.ts:4451 defines supplierLog.filter = 'שורת מחירון שנמחקה'. The import row's entity_id does not resolve in supplier_products, so the fallback fires.
repro: Owner -> /supplier-log. Any row whose action is 'קליטת מחירון'.
expected: A successful import is described as an import. The 'deleted row' fallback belongs to rows that really describe a deleted price line.
actual: The row that carries the operator's reason - the one row of the pair that is worth reading - is the one labelled as a deletion. Confirms the report relayed by the coordinator.

title: Every reasoned price command is duplicated by a reason-less row-trigger row, and the screen shows both
evidence: audit_logs sample of the 60 most recent supplier/supplier_products rows: actions {update:18, insert:33, supplier_prices_imported:2, supplier_product_price_set:6, supplier_bank_details_migrated:1}; 51 of 60 carry reason=null. The pairing is visible row by row: 22:59:45 supplier_prices_imported reason='בדיקת QA — שחזור מחירים…' sits beside six supplier_products 'update' rows at the identical timestamp with reason=null; 21:57:33 supplier_product_price_set reason='בדיקת QA — החזרת מחיר מקורי' beside an 'update' at the same timestamp with reason=null.
expected: Sensitive actions are audited with a reason (constitution). One write should produce one readable ledger entry.
actual: The row-level supplier_products_audit trigger writes an unreasoned row for the same write the reasoned command already recorded, so the log reads as ~85% unattributed. Explains the coordinator's '24 of the last 25 reason-less rows are bulk price writes': they are not unattributed writes, they are the trigger's shadow of attributed ones. Severity unchanged from the prior sweep; recorded here with the mechanism.

title: The subscription screen promises quota usage and the current plan's contents, and shows neither
evidence: Screenshot 42-subscription.png and full page text in out/owner-screens/readonly-screens.json. Header: 'המסלול שהעסק נמצא בו, מה כולל כל אחד מהמסלולים, וכמה מהמכסה נוצל בתקופה הזו'. The page then renders the plan badge ('לקוח ותיק' / 'פעיל') and the five-plan catalogue חינם/בסיס/פרו/פרימיום/ביזנס. There is no usage or quota section anywhere in the page text. rpc/my_entitlements returns for this org: assistant_runs.monthly {numeric_limit: null, measured: false}.
expected: The screen states what it says it states: how much of the period's quota is used, and what the plan the business is actually on includes.
actual: Neither appears. 'לקוח ותיק' is not one of the five cards, so the owner cannot see what their own plan covers; and no consumption figure is shown at all. This matters concretely - the sweep's assistant work was blocked by an exhausted monthly quota that this screen is the designated place to see.

title: Two numbers on one screen answer 'how much is waiting for your decision': 40 and 737, neither carrying its unit
evidence: Screenshot 43-doc-operations.png tile 'דורש טיפול / ממתין להחלטה שלך' = 40. Screenshot 44-doc-operations-bottom.png, same screen, price-list table footer '737 רשומות', every row 'נדרשת החלטה'.
repro: Owner -> /documents/operations, compare the header tile with the lower table's footer.
expected: Per §12 the manager gets one trustworthy picture. If the two counts measure different units (documents vs price-list lines), each should say so.
actual: Both are labelled as awaiting a human decision with no unit, so the screen gives two answers to the same question and the reader cannot reconcile them.

title: Three documents sit in the console under 'מצב לא ידוע' - the console cannot name their state
evidence: Screenshot 43-doc-operations.png / agent-owner-11 output. Rows: consolidated-page-1.png 03.09.2026 00:43, consolidated-page-1.png 03.09.2026 00:41, WhatsApp Image 2026-08-16 at 14.02.58.jpeg 02.09.2026 20:43 - all state 'מצב לא ידוע', attempts 0. The header tiles read דורש טיפול 40 / בעיבוד 0 / תקועות 3 / הושלם 8; these three are not visibly attributable to any of them.
expected: The console over the pipeline names every state it displays, and offers the next action. A state named 'unknown' with zero attempts is a document that never entered the pipeline and should say so.
actual: Three documents, up to 2 days old, are shown with no state and no cause. An operator cannot tell whether they need action, and the summary tiles do not obviously count them.

title: Setting and then clearing a second currency's tolerance permanently rewrites the stored shape; there is no path back
evidence: organizations.settings before: {"bank_match_days":7,"bank_match_amount_tolerance":1}. After setting USD=2.5 and clearing it again: {"bank_match_days":7,"bank_match_amount_tolerance":{"ILS":1}}. Verified on the server row at 23:39 (agent-owner-13). Mechanism, tolerances.ts writeTolerance: the scalar-preserving branch requires `typeof setting === 'number'`, but by the time the last currency is removed the value in hand is already the promoted map, so the map is returned.
repro: Owner -> /settings -> tolerances -> type a value for a second currency -> save -> clear it -> save.
expected: writeTolerance's own comment: 'A map that says only what the scalar said stays a scalar… a diff nobody asked for on a financial settings row is a diff somebody has to explain later.'
actual: The scalar never comes back through the UI. No behavioural difference - storedTolerance reads 1 and {ILS:1} identically - but the stored shape of a financial settings row changed and cannot be restored from the product. Disclosed because it is the one value in my save table I could not restore byte-for-byte.

title: A webhook subscription cannot be deleted - the lifecycle has no last step
evidence: No delete/remove path in src/lib/webhooks.ts or src/pages/WebhookSettings.tsx. Migrations expose register_webhook_subscription, configure_webhook_subscription, set_webhook_subscription_active and read_webhook_subscriptions only (0066, 0198); no delete RPC. Live evidence: subscription 47b1a019-b4e5-4f56-836b-304d145f9b09, url https://app.inplace.digital/inplace-qa-webhook-sink, left behind by an earlier sweep, still present and unremovable.
repro: Owner -> /settings/webhooks. Nothing on the card or in any menu removes a connection.
expected: A connection an owner created can be removed, or the screen says plainly that deactivation is the only removal and why.
actual: Deactivate is the only exit. Every connection ever registered accumulates on the screen permanently. This is why I did not create a second one for the create-half of the lifecycle test.

title: The audit ledger is hard-capped at the last 400 rows with no paging and no date filter
evidence: SupplierLog.tsx query: .order('created_at', {ascending:false}).limit(400). Screen meta reads '344 עדכונים בתצוגה · 400 האחרונים'. Measured: no pagination control of any kind on the screen (agent-owner-14 scanned for הבא/הקודם/עוד/טען/עמוד - zero matches). Filters offered: entity type and supplier only; no date range, no actor, no reason.
expected: An audit ledger reaches its history, or says what it is hiding.
actual: Row 401 and older are unreachable from the product. Not yet biting (344 of 400), but 321 of those 344 were generated in a single night of price writes, so the cap will start silently dropping supplier history quickly. 'ההיסטוריה נשמרת' is what the empty state promises.

title: The VAT rate this tenant is configured with (17.5%) matches neither the code default nor the rate real supplier documents print
evidence: Measured from the server row: organizations.vat_rate = 17.50 (rest/v1/organizations, 23:39). Field #settings-vat-rate shows 17.5 with min=0 max=100 step=0.5. Settings.tsx:83 falls back to '18' when the column is null; Onboarding.tsx:301 does the same. Another agent reports real supplier documents print 18.00%.
expected: One rate, agreeing with the documents the business receives.
actual: Three-way comparison as measured: /settings says 17.5, the product's own default for an unset organisation is 18, and supplier documents print 18.00. I did NOT change it - it is stored per invoice at issue time, so moving it would alter live financial arithmetic. This is a report, not a fix, and the decision is the owner's.

title: 'טווח ימים להתאמת בנק' carries no bound in the DOM while the VAT field beside it does
evidence: Measured attributes on a live load (agent-owner-03): #settings-vat-rate {min:'0', max:'100', step:'0.5'}; #settings-match-days {min:'', max:'', step:''}. src/lib/inputBounds.ts exports VAT_RATE_MIN/MAX and QUANTITY_MAX and nothing for the bank-match window; saveOrg validates the VAT rate with isVatRateInRange and passes Number(matchDays) through unchecked.
repro: Owner -> /settings, inspect the two number inputs.
expected: 0295 ('a bound the screen cannot be asked to keep') gave numeric ceilings to the fields that need them; a day-range window that feeds bank matching is one of them.
actual: No min, no max, no client validation. I did NOT write an out-of-range value: bank matching is shared state and another agent is reconciling against it tonight, so I report the missing constraint from the DOM rather than by corrupting the window.

title: The setup wizard opens pre-filled with the live business record and nothing marks its first button as a write to it
evidence: Screenshot 45-onboarding-step1.png. Step 1 'פרטי העסק' loads with שם העסק = 'עסק לדוגמה' and שיעור מע״מ = 17.5 read from the live organisation; ח.פ, אימייל, טלפון, כתובת empty. The button is 'שמירה והמשך'. Onboarding.tsx:310-330: save() writes organizations.name, vat_rate and settings.business for the real org. Steps 2-4 show 'הושלם' for an organisation that has been trading for months.
repro: Owner -> /settings -> 'רשימת הקמה', or the sidebar 'הקמת המערכת'.
expected: A wizard that edits the live business record says so before the first save.
actual: It reads as a setup form for a new business and is in fact an editor over the live one. The settings merge is correct (settings.business is nested, so the tolerance keys survive), and the four empty fields are empty because this org never set them - so there is no data loss here today. The hazard is presentational, and it is the reason I stopped at this button. FIRST WRITING STEP: 'שמירה והמשך' on step 1. Step navigation itself is safe - progress lives in localStorage (progressKey/saveProgress), not on the server.

title: The URL field's refusals never appear while typing, only on submit
evidence: agent-owner-07 typed eight URLs into the registration form - example.invalid, plain http, 127.0.0.1, localhost, embedded credentials, port 8443, the inet_aton loopback 2130706433, and a well-formed host - and after each one the only text on screen was the static hint 'רק HTTPS על פורט 443, שם דומיין ציבורי, בלי שם משתמש או סיסמה בכתובת.' Identical for the valid URL and all seven invalid ones. Submitting with a short secret did produce a specific message ('סוד החתימה חייב להיות באורך 32–200 תווים'), so refusals are submit-time.
repro: Owner -> /settings/webhooks -> 'חיבור חדש' -> type any rejected URL class.
expected: webhooks.ts states the intent: 'webhookUrlRejection exists so the owner learns "that address is not reachable from here" while typing, instead of after a round trip.'
actual: Nothing is said while typing. The eight URL classes are correctly refused (webhookUrlRejection is wired into submitDraft at WebhookSettings.tsx:131), so this is a feedback gap, not a security gap. Labelled REGRESSION against the file's own documented behaviour rather than against a measured earlier build - I have no before-image of this screen, and say so.

title: RETRACTION / severity change: webhook-verify is reachable from the browser - the earlier no-CORS finding no longer reproduces
evidence: Driven end to end from the app at 23:5x: rpc/request_webhook_verification -> 200, then functions/v1/webhook-verify POST from the page origin -> HTTP 200, body {"ok":true,"verified":false,"code":"webhook_verification_status_405"} read successfully by the page. A browser blocked by a missing CORS handler cannot read that body. An unauthenticated probe of the same function returns a clean 401 UNAUTHORIZED_NO_AUTH_HEADER.
expected: n/a - this is a retraction of a prior finding, per the brief's instruction to retract when re-testing disagrees.
actual: The call completes and its body is readable from the browser. My earlier bare OPTIONS probe in this same sweep reported 'no access-control-allow-origin' and I am retracting that too: an explicit fetch with method OPTIONS is not a preflight and proves nothing about CORS. The real call is the measurement. What remains true is OWN-03: the call succeeds and its verified:false result is not shown to the owner.
